description: Search the used cars currently for sale on Motor Row, a nationwide marketplace of dealer listings. All filters optional. Returns a count and up to `limit` cars, each with a plain-English summary, price, mileage, location, photos, the selling dealer's contact details, and links. Listing data was entered by the dealer and is not verified by Motor Row.

fuel.description: electrified = hybrids, plug-in hybrids and electric cars

query.description: Plain-language search, e.g. "red awd suv under 30k low miles", "2019 or newer f150 in ohio", "cheapest hybrid". Prices, years, mileage, body style, fuel, drivetrain, transmission, color, state and makes or models on the lot are understood; other words are matched against year, make, model, trim, city and description. The structured arguments below take priority over the same thing said here.

state.description: Two-letter U.S. state where the car is located, e.g. "IN"

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code. Alone: cars in that ZIP. With within_miles: cars within that distance of it.

name: search_cars
